membership.question: How do I sign up for Hedef Okul?
membership.answer: Click the "Sign Up" button on the site and create a free account with your email address and a password in seconds. Right after signing up you get instant access to every worksheet and exam.

pricing.question: Are the worksheets paid?
pricing.answer: The vast majority of worksheets on the platform are free. Every student can preview content before signing up, and use it in full afterwards.

teacher.question: Can I create my own exams as a teacher?
teacher.answer: Yes! Sign in with a teacher account to build exams and worksheets tailored to subject, topic and grade level, then assign them to your students. AI-powered question detection helps you along the way.

parent.question: Can I follow my child's progress as a parent?
parent.answer: Yes. With a parent account you can follow the exams your child completes, the scores they get and the badges they earn in real time — so you can be there at every step of their learning.
